Method of Attack: POST-based reflected XSS (cross-site scripting) allowing privilege escalation and information theft
Broken access control on form submissions export feature allowing Subscribers and Contributors to export all user-submitted data
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Ninja Forms plugin versions 3.6.25 and older
Attack Vector: Tricking privileged users into visiting specially-crafted webpages (for XSS)
Exploitation of broken access control in form submissions export feature
